ops.body: Confirmed mechanism: plugins/codex/main.go:97-109 @5be8f3a stores the resolved versioned executable in selfPath; plugins/codex/detach.go:33,67 @5be8f3a later reexec it. Homebrew deleted that pathname during the observed update. Verified exact old bytes were restored at the canonical old pathname; global1.14.25 stayed unchanged. Existing daemonkit Stable @v0.35.1 program.go:60 is a mutable per-label launchd placement policy, not a per-generation retained image. Root boundary choice pending: A consumer-private immutable per-generation image (recommended), or B shared SDK primitive plus later adoption. No source edits or local tests/builds; next action is Root boundary decision then isolated source candidate.
